assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE seamless pixel-art ground texture tile for the top-down post-flood survival game 潮汐线 / Tideline. Deliver a SQUARE image consisting of ONLY the texture, covering the ENTIRE canvas, fully opaque all the way to all four edges. It is a flat material sample viewed directly from above; no perspective plane, no isometric slab, no raised tile, no side faces, no shadow, no frame, no margin, no text, no logo, no background outside the texture. Design it as exactly 32 x 32 LOGICAL PIXELS enlarged by nearest-neighbour for viewing, with chunky clean square pixel clusters, crisp hard edges and a restrained 12-16 colour palette. It must remain legible when downsampled to the actual 32x32 game tile. The four edges must TILE SEAMLESSLY when repeated horizontally and vertically: maintain equal brightness and material density at every edge, continue the pattern across opposite edges; no vignette, no dark perimeter, no directional lighting gradient, no central focal object. Quiet weathered desaturated materials that support small characters and loot sprites. Subject: OLD STREET STONE PAVEMENT. Cool grey-green worn rectangular stone pavers, about four courses of masonry in one 32px tile, broad readable stone blocks and thin low-contrast mortar, a restrained staggered repeating layout compatible across opposite edges. Subtle chips and two or three tiny sparse wear pixels only; dry flat stones, not cobblestones, no grass clumps. Palette centred on muted #65736a, #7e8a7d and soft #47584e; do not use pure black or bright highlights. Quiet uniform illumination, flat flush road surface. This is a repeatable patch from the middle of a road, NOT a standalone square paving slab.

visualReview.note: 复查32px辨识度与不加网格的连续铺设；河水采用v3粗像素短波纹。
